items.q: I have an idea, but no specification. Where do we start?
items.a: We start with a conversation about goals, users and context. Then we propose discovery or a prototype to clarify scope and test assumptions before committing to development.

items.q: Can Nexora work with our existing engineering team?
items.a: Yes. Through Dedicated Team or Time & Material engagements, Nexora engineers can work with your existing team. Responsibilities, code review, communication and access arrangements are agreed at the start.

items.q: How are source-code ownership and confidentiality handled?
items.a: Ownership, source-code handover, data use and NDA terms are defined in each project contract. We discuss confidentiality requirements before accessing your documents or systems.

items.q: Who supports the product after launch?
items.a: Nexora provides maintenance and operations services. Support scope, response times, monitoring and incident processes are agreed around your system’s needs.

items.q: How do we get a cost and timeline estimate?
items.a: Share the challenge, existing documentation and your desired timeline. Once scope is clear, Nexora proposes an approach, engagement model and estimate with explicit assumptions.
